Zoho CRM

Build an organized enquiry pipeline that teams can maintain.

ZCOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Zoho CRM supports customer records, sales processes, automation, and documented APIs. MoreSpace can turn a team's enquiry flow into a structured workspace with clear record ownership, qualification stages, follow-up responsibilities, and reporting that connects acquisition activity with meaningful customer outcomes.

Useful outputs

  • Structured CRM modules and owner-specific enquiry views
  • Reviewed routing or synchronization rules and follow-up tasks
  • Pipeline reports and a practical CRM maintenance process

Where we can apply it

  • Validated enquiry → CRM contact match → assigned owner → sales follow-up.
  • Qualified prospect → reviewed deal record → stage progression → pipeline report.
  • Overdue next action → owner-specific queue → completed follow-up → response review.
01

Use case 1

Configure enquiry and deal stages with owner, next action, and qualification criteria.

02

Use case 2

Connect validated form or outreach records through scoped CRM API operations.

03

Use case 3

Create pipeline views and follow-up reports for sales and delivery teams.

Inputs we need

  • Current enquiry records and customer relationship definitions
  • Sales stages, assignment roles, and follow-up expectations
  • Authorized API access and approved external field mappings

Delivery sequence

  • Model the record fields and stage transitions with the sales team.
  • Clean starting records and test scoped integrations and owner assignment.
  • Verify role permissions, regional API behavior, and agreed report calculations.

Expert review points

  • Review duplicate identities and conflicting fields before importing or updating records.
  • Approve assignment responsibilities and stage definitions before live routing.
